programme.desc: The Loobenfeld Decay: Leonard and Sheldon each tell a lie to avoid going to see Penny singing on stage in a production of Rent, but Sheldon's fib gets out of control.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Pancake Batter Anomaly: Penny volunteers to nurse Sheldon when he's sick. But his friends, who know how miserable he is when he's ill, stay well away.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Old School: Peralta is overjoyed when his hero, crime reporter Jimmy Brogan, visits the precinct, but things soon go awry. Jeffords and Boyle prepare Diaz for a day in court.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Sal's Pizza: When Peralta's favourite restaurant burns down, the fire marshal assumes that the owner is the prime suspect. A virus hits the precinct's computers.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Love Is a Many-Splintered Thing: Bart's heartstrings are pulled once again when Mary Spuckler returns to Springfield, but he doesn't pay her enough attention.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Hardly Kirk-ing: Bart and Milhouse explore the perks of adulthood when a hair-shaving experiment leaves Milhouse looking exactly like his dad Kirk.

programme.title: Married at First Sight UK: Reunion
programme.desc: Reunion: Brand new series - It's the reunion dinner party and in true MAFS style, across-the-table action is served as two brides clash. And one groom faces a reckoning!

programme.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
programme.desc: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister that features a variety of cats doing strange things, some soldiers stuck in the sand and a dog balancing on a rope.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Selma's Choice: After Homer gets sick from a giant sandwich he's been eating for months, Selma steps in to take the kids to a new alcohol-based theme park.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Brother from the Same Planet: When Homer is late picking up Bart from a school football game, Bart gets a surrogate dad from an agency.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Sky Police: Chief Wiggum uses a military jet pack to fight crime. But when he crashes into the church, Marge and the congregation resort to gambling to pay for the repairs.

programme.title: New: Come Dine with Me: Teens
programme.desc: Brand new series: Alex goes all-out by making absolutely everything from scratch. Will the fruits of his labour pay off with his dessert, or will he crumble under the pressure? (Ep5/5)

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: Kyle Hagler: The models are in Milan for meetings with four fashion houses, including Versace. And the contestants are painted like statues for a shoot on Lake Como.

programme.title: New: Married at First Sight UK
programme.desc: Reunion: Brand new series - In the reunion Commitment Ceremony, some couples celebrate their journeys, others confront their issues, and one final admission rocks the group.

programme.title: New: MAFS UK: It's Official!
programme.desc: With Lucinda Light: Brand new series - Lucinda dissects all the drama and finds out what her guests Bimini, Davide and Mel really think about the biggest MAFS UK 2025 moments!

programme.title: European Qualifier
programme.desc: England v Serbia (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from the FIFA World Cup Group K qualifier at Wembley Stadium. England produced an excellent display in September's reverse fixture to win 5-0 in Belgrade, with five different players finding the net, and they followed that up with a victory by the same scoreline in Latvia that secured their place at next year's World Cup. It remains to be seen whether Thomas Tuchel will look to experiment with his side or continue building momentum with the strongest team he has available to him, but Serbia are in need of a result as they are battling it out with Albania for second place in the group and a spot in the play-offs. With analysis from Ian Wright and Roy Keane, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon

programme.desc: Caroline continues the night by returning to slasher territory with the 1989 horror Offerings; produced, written and directed by Christopher Reynolds.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Brother and sister duo Inez and Charlie Foxx perform the spectacular hit Mockingbird.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: Blind Man's Bluff. Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Look At Life The Rocket-Age Lancers
programme.desc: 1961. A look to the future with the 9th Queen's Royal Lancers, a cavalry regiment of the British Army which was first formed in 1715.

programme.title: Mrs. Pym of Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1939. Detective Drama. Directed by Fred Elles. Starring Mary Clare, Edward Lexy & Nigel Patrick. A woman detective sets about solving the murder of people who have all frequented the same medium.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: British Finches/Yerro's Operation. 1986. Jack sees almost every member of the British finch family in a country garden before recounting the story of his noisy mule, Yerro.

programme.title: Burnt Evidence
programme.desc: 1954. Drama starring Jane Hylton, Duncan Lamont and Donald Gray. Lamont plays the jealous husband of Hylton. When confronting her lover, he accidentally shoots the man and runs for the hills.

programme.title: The Royal Mint
programme.desc: Made in the 1940s, interesting little film made by the Canadian film bureau showing the workings of The Royal Mint and how to ingots were made for a coronation.

programme.title: Churchill's Secret Army

programme.title: Rumpole of the Bailey
programme.desc: Rumpole and the Golden Thread. Stars: Leo McKern, Peggy Thorpe-Bates & Errol John. Rumpole agrees to defend a cabinet minister of a former British African colony accused of murder.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Tonight and Every Night. 1975. Stars Stephanie Turner, Mitzi Rogers & Alan Lake. A midnight motoring accident reveals a great deal more than just careless driving.

programme.title: Linda
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Directed by Don Sharp. Stars Carol White, Alan Rothwell & Lois Daine. A bored teenager finds excitement in the life of crime, but his interests change when he starts to fall in love.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: A captivating jukebox film from 1963 of the Kessler Sisters performing their song Quando Quando Quando!

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: Blood and Water. 1976. Stars Jean Anderson & Colin Baker. Brian abstains from a vote in Merroney's offer. Jane moves closer to Brian, but learns they are on different sides of the upcoming vote.

programme.title: Wellington Bomber
programme.desc: 2010. Documentary. Directed by Peter Williams. The story of the Wellington, the great British bomber of WWII, featuring archival footage and interviews with some of the workers who built them.

programme.title: Cactus Flower
programme.desc: 1969. Comedy. Directed by Gene Saks. Stars Walter Matthau, Ingrid Bergman & Goldie Hawn. A dentist convinces his assistant to pose as his wife so he can avoid marrying his girlfriend.

programme.title: Strange But True
programme.desc: Psychic Pets/The Mystery of Dark Peak. 1996. Michael Aspel examines the question of the mysterious lights of Longdendale Valley and looks at the phenomenon of perceptive pets.

programme.title: Scotland Yard

programme.title: Van der Valk

programme.title: I, The Jury

programme.title: Goldeneye

programme.title: Yield to the Night

programme.title: Valentino

programme.title: Born Of The Sea

programme.title: Air Crossroads London

programme.title: Hyde Park Corner
